tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ tshe sgrub nyi zla kha sbyor las/ nyer mkho 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i 'chi bslu'i rim pa bklag chog bzhugs so//

tshe sgrub 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i nyer mkho 'chi bslu'i cho ga ni bzhi/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'o/ dang po phyi'i 'chi bslu ni/ gtor ma sats+tsha srog 'don sogs bya zhing*/ gzhan yang rig 'dzin sangs rgyas gling pa'i zab gter tshe sgrub nyi zla kha sbyor las/ rang nyid kha sna'i chu dag dang : 'bru nag dri chen dri chu dang : skra sen lus bkrus khu ba yis: 'bru sna'i ngar phye sbrus pa la: mi gzugs dkar ser dmar ljang dang : khra bo gcig dang lnga byas la: dar tshon bal tshon sna lnga gzug: chang zan rang gi gos dum bkon: sngags drug phyag rgya'i ting 'dzin gyis: byin gyis brlabs la 'di skad do: hūm̐: bcom ldan shākya thub pa'i byin rlabs dang : thal mo khang stong āḥdakar 'od zer gyis: glud gtor nyes skyon dri ma dag par gyur: oṃ swa bha wa sogs/ mdun du bgegs chen sde bzhi la: lha klu bdud btsan rgyal bsen dang : tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med nas: tshe srog bar du gcod pa yi: lan chags glud kyi bdag po rnams: dpag med khrom tshogs bzhin du gsal: bh+rāt+s+mum̐ las rin chen snod mchog rgya che ba: stong gsum tsam gyi nang du kham̐ yig las: ngar gyi mi chen khog stod gser las grub: khog smad dngul dang sked pa mchong las grub: lag pa gser dngul rkang pa zangs dang lcags: zho sha'i snying dang mu tig klad pa dang : long thang mig la zer mang sgro yi skra: byi ru'i ljags la mgron bu'i so byas pa: khams dang skye mched dbang po yongs su rdzogs: smra mkhas ljags ljags 'gro mkhas ldem ldem byed: gcig las brgya stong bye ba dung phyur 'phro: snang srid lha 'dre bgegs rigs spyan lam du: mi bas glud bzang lha yi bu pho 'dra: glud gtor so so'i yid mthun 'dod yon lnga : zag med stong gsum 'jig rten gang bar gyur: bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan byin rlabs kyis: mchod sbyin phyag rgya trāṃ ser 'od 'phros pas:

mgron rnams kun la zad med longs spyod gyur: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba sogs/ bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas byin rlabs kyis: pad+ma'i phyag rgya hrīḥdamar 'od zer 'phros: glud gtor 'chi sos sman gyi bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ bcom ldan don yod grub pa'i byin rlabs kyis: skyabs sbyin phyag rgya hāḥljang 'od zer gyis: bsngos pa tsam gyis mgron rnams tshim gyur cig: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: bcom ldan mi bskyod pa yi byin rlabs kyis: sa gnon phyag rgya hūm̐ sngon 'od zer gyis: 'thab rtsod pham rgyal med par thob par gyur: oṃ dz+nyā na a wa lo ki te na maḥs man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi bha wa sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hriḥd ya dz+wa la ni hūm̐: bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad byin rlabs kyis: byang chub phyag rgya oṃ dkar 'od zer gyis: mgron rnams bdag gi dbang du 'dus par gyur: oṃ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha naṃ gra he shwa ri pra bhañdza ti ma hā sa ma ya swā hāḥ hūm̐: 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing : bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms byed pa: dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha: bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod: nam mkha' stong pa 'gug byed na: sems can rnams la smos ci dgos: sems med pa yang 'gug byed na: lus sems ldan la smos ci dgos: 'di ru gnod byed dgug tu gsol: na mo: sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden= dge 'dun gyi bka'= gsang sngags dang : rig sngags dang : gzungs sngags dang : snying po dang : phyag rgya dang : de bzhin nyid kyi bka' bden pa dang : bden pa chen po'i mthus sbyin pa'i bdag po'i mchan/ bdag gi tshe srog la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad glud kyi gtor ma len pa'i slad du 'dir mchis par gyur cig:

lan gsum/ rin chen mang dang gzugs mdzes dang : 'jam klas 'jigs kun bral ba yi: de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: zhes byin brlabs nas/ hūm̐: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po dang : steng 'og bar gsum gdon tshogs dang : pho 'dre mo 'dre ma ning gdon: dregs pa sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas: bdag bas lhag pa'i glud gtor 'di: khyer cig khyer cig stobs ldan rnams: 'dod sred chags dang zhen pa dang : dran dang mthong reg bzung ba kun: brtul zhig lhod cig da khrol zhig: sngon gyi lan chags sha 'khon dang : bu lon 'phral gyi rkyen la sogs: gang yin ma lus 'khor bar mdzod: de ring yon gyi bdag po yi: 'chi rkyen ma lus bsgyur du gsol: bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni: de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang : chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis: gdon bgegs 'byung po ma lus pa: bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig: hūm̐: nyon cig log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs: byang chub sgrub la mi dga' zhing : lus sems sbyor ba ngan pa yis: mi la gnod cing 'tshe byed pa: tshe la brku zhing srog la 'jab: gshed dang lcag dang bla khyer byed: 'byung po'i rigs ni gang yang rung : bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang : byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga dang : nad yams dal gyi bdag mo sogs: tshe dang srog la gnod byed pa'i: bdud sde dpung bcas phyir dengs shig: lan chags glud gtor byin nas kyang : bsgo ba'i bka' la mi nyan na: dbang chen khros pa'i nga rgyal gyis: rta skad 'tsher zhing mtshon chas gtub: rdo rje 'dzin yang 'jigs nus na: bgegs tshogs rnams la smos ci dgos: lus ngag thal bar brlag nas kyang : sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar 'gyur: de bas ma rungs gdug pa'i tshogs: skad cig nyid la phyir dengs shig: oṃ sum+bha ni sogs sham du tshe dang srog la bar du gcod pa thams cad u tsa ta ya phaṭaḥ

ces brjod phyi mig mi blta bar: chu chen gzhung du bskur la btang : lo gsum 'chi ba bzlog par 'gyur: 'chi ltas phra mo ma byung yang : lo zad zla smad byas gyur na: rim gro kun gyi mchog tu 'gyur: zhes so/ zhes pa 'di ni h+ya ghṛ wa na thas 'khyer bder bsgrigs pa 'dis kyang skye 'gro mtha' dag 'chi bdag gi g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyur gyur cig //
